newsitem.title: USA: St. Petersburg, Fla., mulls bonds for Devil Rays.
newsitem.headline: St. Petersburg, Fla., mulls bonds for Devil Rays.

text.p: St. Petersburg, Fla., Mayor David Fischer proposed bond financing for $8.2 million of upgrades to the Devil Rays' spring training facilities, St. Petersburg Times reported Thursday.
The major league baseball team leases three city-owned faciliites -- Al Lang Stadium, the Cardinals Complex and Huggins-Stengel Field.

Under Fischer's proposal, the Devil Rays would take over the facilities and pay up to $800,000 a year in operating costs. Money the city would have otherwise used to pay operating costs would be use to pay debt service on the bonds.
The team and the city were still negotiating details of the plan, the newspaper said.
